meta_data.base_class: Allow users to submit reviews for purchased <products> - refers to various goods or content that can be bought and subjectively evaluated by consumers.

tool_template.name: submit<class>Review
tool_template.description: Allows users to submit a review for a <class> they have purchased.

UserName.description: Name of the user submitting the review for the <class>.

ReviewText.description: Text content of the user's review.

Rating.description: Numerical rating given to the <class> by the user (1 to 5).

PurchaseDate.description: The date when the <class> was purchased. This helps verify the authenticity of the review.

UsageDuration.description: The duration in days that the user has spent using or experiencing the <class>. This provides context to the rating and review.

Location.description: The geographical location where the <class> was primarily used. This can provide insights into region-specific experiences.

RecommendToOthers.description: Indicates whether the user would recommend the <class> to others. This adds qualitative value to the review.

VerifiedPurchase.description: Indicates if the <class> review is from a verified purchase, ensuring the reliability of the review.
